verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no general-purpose public REST/HTTP API, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the standard paths all returned 404. Qodo does offer documented programmatic surfaces: an official MCP server that connects Toolbox skills (retrieve and resolve findings, fetch rules) to custom agents, workflows or applications; a CLI; and configuration-as-code via .pr_agent.toml. Together these let an agent drive part of the product, but not the whole platform. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API with a reference or OpenAPI spec, API coverage of core review/governance/configuration operations beyond Toolbox skills, auth and API-key documentation, and independent corroboration of API use.
